╭─┐help┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮╯│
│        Key:        Description:                                            │─╯
│          C         Expand/collapse the selected process' children.         │─╮
│   Pg Up, Pg Down   Jump 1 page in process list.                            │%│
│      Home, End     Jump to first or last page in process list.             │8│
│     Left, Right    Select previous/next sorting column.                    │0│
│        b, n        Select previous/next network device.                    │6│
│          i         Toggle disks io mode with big graphs.                   │5│
│          z         Toggle totals reset for current network device          │9│
│          a         Toggle auto scaling for the network graphs.             │2│
│          y         Toggle synced scaling mode for network graphs.          │6│
│        f, /        To enter a process filter. Start with ! for regex.      │6│
│          F         Follow selected process.                                │ │
│          u         Pause process list.                                     │ │
│       delete       Clear any entered filter.                               │ │
│          c         Toggle per-core cpu usage of processes.                 │ │
│          r         Reverse sorting order in processes box.                 │ │
